body.title: Ai trainer
body.aiReason: Job focuses on AI tool training for agents, not data analysis/visualization or pipeline work; description doesn't match core positioning.
body.description:
Landmark Elite Homes is looking for an experienced AI Trainer / AI Assistant Specialist to help our real estate agents learn how to effectively use AI as part of their everyday business.
We are looking for someone who can go beyond simply explaining ChatGPT. We want our agents to understand how to use AI as a practical assistant to help them generate more leads, prospect consistently, follow up with clients, create marketing content, organize their business, and become more productive.
The goal is to give our agents simple, repeatable AI systems they can actually use every day.
